intent: Breathing. The upper body settles 1 px on the exhale and returns; pelvis, legs and sash stay planted so the feet never move.
units: Track values are whole-pixel [dx, dy] offsets per frame (a plain number is dy). Positive dy moves down.
rules: At a joint, the upper part is never higher than the part below it (head >= torso, hair cap >= upper fall >= lower fall), so no gap ever opens: the head drops first and rises last; the hair falls settle after the cap and rise before it.
Arms lag the torso on the way down but return with it: in the profiles the torso sits directly above the near arm, so an arm lower than the torso would open a gap at that seam.
In NE and NW the far forearm sits directly above torso pixels, so the arms move exactly with the torso there (directionTracks).
Pelvis, legs and sash have no track and stay at 0; the feet stay on the pivot.
